title: digital financial literacy, entrepreneurial competencies and local government initiatives: keys to smes’ sustainability
core_idea: Assess how local government initiatives, digital financial literacy, and entrepreneurial competencies jointly influence the long-term sustainability of small and medium-sized enterprises in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.
tldr: This mixed-method study investigates factors that support SME sustainability in Yogyakarta by combining qualitative interviews with policy officials to inform a survey, and a quantitative survey of SME owners analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling, aiming to inform policy and capacity-building in a digital economy.
